{"initial_observation":{"company":"CLOSE_fin_02","message":"The ledger is accessed through the supplied SQL tools."},"max_actions":10,"task":"Company CLOSE_fin_02 keeps a single heterogeneous ledger table. Every record type is stored in ledger, so SQL self-joins and CTEs can be used. Close the payable ledger as it was known at recorded_at <= 2026-10-24T12:00:00, for business_date <= 2026-10-23. All timestamps are UTC ISO text. Start by excluding rows with future business dates and rows recorded late, then keep only the highest revision for each (kind,event_key). If that latest row has status void, the key is removed entirely; never fall back to an older row. Invoice rows use event_key as the invoice ID; payment, credit and hold rows use invoice_id to point to their parent invoice. Keep the active invoices for vendor BLUE with due_date <= 2026-10-30. Payments and credits reduce the gross amount_minor, in the invoice currency. Active holds reduce the remaining amount; holds with status release or void do not. Clamp as follows: remaining=max(0,gross-sum(payments)-sum(credits)), then unheld=max(0,remaining-sum(active holds)). For each invoice, pick the active terms row that has the same terms_code and the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date (applying the same revision and as-of filtering). The discounted amount is unheld * (10000-discount_bps)/10000 only when 2026-10-23 <= discount_until; otherwise it is unheld. Next, pick the active FX row for that invoice's currency with the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date. Convert to USD cents using fx_num/fx_den. Round only this final per-invoice amount to the nearest cent, rounding exact halves up. Sum the rounded per-invoice USD cents. Invoices in USD also have FX rows. Do not net invoices together before rounding. Submit only the integer number of USD cents.","task_id":"fin-02","tools":[{"description":"Get a list of available table names for a company.","name":"get_descriptions","parameters":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"company_name":{"description":"The name of the company","type":"string"}},"required":["company_name"],"type":"object"}},{"description":"Get table metadata: description, columns, types, unique values.","name":"get_table_info","parameters":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"company_name":{"description":"The name of the company","type":"string"},"table_name":{"description":"The name of the table","type":"string"}},"required":["company_name","table_name"],"type":"object"}},{"description":"Execute a SQL query on a table. {"tool":"sql_query","arguments":{"company_name":"CLOSE_fin_02","table_name":"ledger","query":"WITH eligible AS (SELECT * FROM ledger WHERE business_date <= '2026-10-23' AND recorded_at <= '2026-10-24T12:00:00'), ranked AS (SELECT eligible.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY kind, event_key ORDER BY revision DESC) AS rn FROM eligible), active AS (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 AND status <> 'void'), invoices AS (SELECT * FROM active WHERE kind = 'invoice' AND vendor = 'BLUE' AND due_date <= '2026-10-30'), balances AS (SELECT i.event_key, i.currency, i.business_date, i.amount_minor - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount_minor) FROM active p WHERE p.kind = 'payment' AND p.invoice_id = i.event_key), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.amount_minor) FROM active c WHERE c.kind = 'credit' AND c.invoice_id = i.event_key), 0) AS gross_remaining, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(h.amount_minor) FROM active h WHERE h.kind = 'hold' AND h.invoice_id = i.event_key AND h.status = 'active'), 0) AS holds, i.terms_code, i.discount_until FROM invoices i), valued AS (SELECT b.*, MAX(0, gross_remaining) AS remaining FROM balances b), unheld AS (SELECT v.*, MAX(0, remaining - holds) AS payable, (SELECT t.discount_bps FROM active t WHERE t.kind = 'terms' AND t.event_key = v.terms_code AND t.business_date <= v.business_date ORDER BY t.business_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS discount_bps, (SELECT f.fx_num * 1.0 / f.fx_den FROM active f WHERE f.kind = 'fx' AND f.currency = v.currency AND f.business_date <= v.business_date ORDER BY f.business_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS fx_rate FROM valued v), discounts AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN discount_until >= '2026-10-23' THEN payable * (10000 - COALESCE(discount_bps, 0)) / 10000.0 ELSE payable END AS discounted FROM unheld) SELECT SUM(CAST(ROUND(discounted * fx_rate, 0) AS INTEGER)) AS usd_cents FROM discounts WHERE fx_rate IS NOT NULL"}}
